note: cluster/fin_hw.py: HW-b6 dorsal-fin models (checkpoints outside the repo) and their calibrations. train_days = the days whose catalogue animals a fine-tuned run was trained on (moonshot_sizing/fin_tune, pool[:16] of bench.splits()[0]): scores on them are in-sample and they are never used to calibrate that model.

hwb6.what: public HW-b6 as published (liu-peilin/happywhale_b6_pseudo_charm_round2_1024_v2), no training on our days

cal.how: Platt (logistic, no penalty) of same animal on the best day-centred cosine, safe-cluster pairs of one catalogue group > 60 s apart that both show a dorsal fin

hwb6_s16_0.what: HW-b6 fine-tuned on 16 train days, seed 0 (fin_tune run s16_0, 600 steps, blocks 5+ trained)

cal.how: Platt (logistic, no penalty) of same animal on the best day-centred cosine, safe-cluster pairs of one catalogue group > 60 s apart that both show a dorsal fin

hwb6_s16_1.what: HW-b6 fine-tuned on 16 train days, seed 1 (fin_tune run s16_1)

cal.how: Platt (logistic, no penalty) of same animal on the best day-centred cosine, safe-cluster pairs of one catalogue group > 60 s apart that both show a dorsal fin
